bead.title: claude-tui: add shared benchmark prompt fixture and claude --print baseline runner
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 / ADR-013 Performance and Cost Acknowledgement requires a benchmark comparison for claude-tui before promotion, but the test package has no reusable canned prompt fixture or measured claude --print baseline for equivalent prompts.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness_test.go:342 only tests model snapshot parsing behavior; it does not define a benchmark prompt fixture or baseline timing runner.
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness.go:52 wires Execute through the PTY harness identity, but there is no companion test helper that invokes claude --print for apples-to-apples wall-time measurement.
- docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-013-claude-tui-pty-harness-fork.md:443 requires performance/cost acknowledgement, and docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-013-claude-tui-pty-harness-fork.md:451 requires a claude-tui benchmark lane before auto-routing promotion.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add a shared canned prompt fixture for claude-tui benchmark tests under internal/harnesses/claude-tui, using deterministic text suitable for both claude-tui and claude --print.
2. Add a claude --print baseline runner helper in the claudetui test package that measures wall time, captures command stderr/stdout safely, and can be skipped when the live claude binary or auth is unavailable.
3. Add focused unit tests for the fixture and baseline helper using a fake claude script so default CI does not require live Anthropic credentials.

NON-SCOPE:
- PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- Session pool, /clear, orphan reaping (sibling child B).
- AccountHarness and QuotaHarness implementations (sibling child C).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.
- Implementing BenchmarkClaudeTuiTurnWallTime threshold enforcement; this child only supplies the shared fixture and baseline runner.

PARENT: fizeau-60ce39cb.
Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3, CONTRACT-004.
Dependencies preserved: sibling children A, B, C are still required before the final PTY benchmark enforcement child can execute against the real PTY turn path.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestClaudeTuiBenchmarkPromptFixture asserts the shared canned prompt is non-empty, stable, and used by both the baseline helper and the PTY benchmark helper entry points.
2. TestClaudePrintBaselineRunnerUsesPrintMode asserts a fake claude executable is invoked with --print on the shared canned prompt and returns measured wall-time data without using claude-tui internals.
3. TestClaudePrintBaselineRunnerSkipsWhenUnavailable asserts the live baseline path reports a skip/operator-required condition rather than failing default CI when claude or auth is unavailable.
4. go test ./internal/harnesses/claude-tui -run 'TestClaudeTuiBenchmarkPromptFixture|TestClaudePrintBaselineRunnerUsesPrintMode|TestClaudePrintBaselineRunnerSkipsWhenUnavailable' -count=1 is green.
5. go test ./... -count=1 is green.
6. lefthook run pre-commit is green.
